agent_note: Close third-person past narration, very heavy free indirect discourse - many quotes are Furlong's reflective questions rendered in past tense. Quotation marks survive only partially in this book's Goodreads text, so dialogue was identified from surviving closing marks plus speech tags ('she said', 'Furlong said'); q09404/q09412 read as aphorisms with no marks or tags and were bucketed gnomic on present tense alone. Several past-tense generalizations (q09389, q09390, q09393, q09414, q09419, q09431) would be swept into gnomic by a loose specificity test - held as event/past per the present-tense-only rule. q09421/q09422 are the author's historical afterword about the Magdalen laundries, q09425 the dedication, q09427 a Spanish translation leak. 34 event quotes, all past, no present event-narration anywhere in the set.
